root.label: NTSB preliminary report on Malta Air flight incident

events.label: NTSB preliminary report on Malta Air flight incident

slots.name: prior bird strikes
slots.sentence: The plane’s engine is suspected to have been hit by birds four times in the 12 months leading up to the strike last month, investigators said.

slots.name: investigation duration
slots.sentence: The full investigation will take about a year to two years to complete, according to the N.T.S.B.

slots.name: last inspection date
slots.sentence: The engine’s fan blades had been inspected most recently in May, and employees did not flag any findings, according to the report.
